officialComparison.subsetPolicy: Requested FTDNA Stat full labels and all official ancestors; row[3] is the official subtree sum of kits with a reported country, excluding X/Unknown Origin.
officialComparison.policy: Exact full terminal label, all supplied ancestors in order and same direct parent. No new topology imported; official aggregate country-known counts compared separately. No STR, individual identity or age verification.

limitations: Comparison is against the dated official FTDNA snapshot recorded here, independent of the app tree snapshot. Differences in counts between release dates are not evidence of error or tampering.
Kit counts are secondary aggregates of testers with a reported country, not population frequencies or imported sample records.
No age estimates, geographical priors, STR profiles or sample identities enter prediction.
